mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO login_audit_log (event_id, user_id, username, event_type, success, remote_login, previous_ip, ip_address, user_agent, failure_reason, occurred_at, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{eventType}, #{success}, #{remoteLogin}, #{previousIp}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{failureReason}, #{occurredAt}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failure, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN remote_login = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS remoteLogin, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN occurred_at >= CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today FROM login_audit_log
AND user_id = #{userId} AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%') AND event_type = #{eventType} AND success = #{success} AND remote_login = #{remoteLogin} AND occurred_at >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND occurred_at <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
